snippet.description:
It’s one of the biggest scandals of the AI era. Jensen Huang officially resigned as CEO of Nvidia after allegations of an affair with a Chinese spy and an Nvidia employee. Huang built the chips that power AI in the US. AI is an industry China desperately wants to lead, so what would the country benefit from getting information from Huang? Potentially a lot. 

Listen to Today, Explained, wherever you get your podcasts for the full episode.
